value.description: Connected presentation and conveyance of fundamental and specialized knowledge, possibly combined with demonstrations or experiments.
Working through and deepening knowledge with training in subject methodology and special skills by processing and discussing exemplary tasks.

Development of scientific findings or addressing current issues using scientific methods, typically through contributions prepared by students, learning and practicing presentation and discussion techniques.

Guided execution of practical tasks in experimental and apparatus areas and/or computer simulations; training in the application of scientific investigation and solution methods; imparting technical skills and insights into functional processes.

Development of concepts and realization of solutions to complex, practical tasks; imparting social competence through largely independent task processing with ongoing professional and methodological guidance.
Experience of practical work through active participation, typically outside the university, under on-site guidance, usually with professional and methodological support from a teacher.

A preparatory course for conducting tutorials, as well as the implementation of a tutorial; training in imparting subject-specific and didactic skills, as well as learning presentation and discussion techniques.
The program-specific regulations determine the requirements for self-study.
